note: All values are RVAs (ImageBase 0x400000). iat_rva of a function = address of its 4-byte IAT cell. thunk_rva = 12-byte movw/movt/ldr.w pc,[ip] import thunk (null when the exe loads the cell directly via movw/movt+ldr). Cells hold Thumb pointers (bit0 set) after the loader runs.
